assets.prompt: Make ONLY two small local additions to this exact existing open character-dossier book artwork. Image 1 is the SOURCE artwork to edit. Image 2 only shows the game's real composition and separate portrait/text overlays; do NOT bake that interface, Chinese text, extra portrait, tabs, buttons, or background into the output. Return only the complete edited source artwork with exactly the original canvas size, framing, transparent exterior and book geometry. (1) Add ONE small red-flower reward STICKER at the lower-right corner of the blank RIGHT writing sheet, just ABOVE the top edge of the brown leather pocket, near source coordinates x1230,y596 on the 1485x1036 canvas. About 56 pixels across. A simple old Chinese school reward paper sticker: five rounded deep-red printed petals, a tiny muted yellow center, thin ivory die-cut paper edge, slightly worn matte paper, almost flat with a very subtle contact shadow. No stem, leaves, text, smiley face, bow, realistic fresh flower, wax seal or large badge. It should not cover the dotted writing area above y565 or protrude beyond the page. (2) Add ONE very ORDINARY household lock KEY on the LEFT lower exposed leather corner, centered around x249,y801, occupying approximately x181..341,y745..843. A small flat nickel-plated brass single-edge key of the common type used for Chinese household padlocks and old cylinder door locks: plain rounded rectangular/oval flat bow with one small circular hole, a straight thin flat blade, one side with 5 simple teeth cut into the edge. Slight silver-gray tarnish and fine scratches, modest metal thickness, soft contact shadow. Place diagonally with the plain bow toward lower-left and toothed tip toward upper-right. No ornate antique skeleton key, no long cylindrical shaft, no decorative bow, no modern car fob, no electronics, no keyring and no label. Keep this key on the left lower margin, clear of the portrait's face and the writing sheet. Preserve the original left portrait and papers exactly even though the game later overlays its own character portrait there. Preserve all original book leather, seam, blank right page, dots, page wear, folded clipping, source English side tabs, cord, lighting and alpha as closely as possible. Do not redraw or replace the book or paper. No added UI text or watermarks. Save the edited PNG beside the source as E:/东北迪斯科/public/assets/exploration-dossier-redflower-key-v1.png. Do not create a folder.
assets.integration: Only the new key and red-flower regions are displayed through separate SVG contour masks. No generated full book replaces the original; masks also open the key bow hole. The flower is reduced to a small 3.7cqw width.
